preconditions.description: The number of rooms in the hole is between 2 and 105, inclusive.
The room identifiers are between 1 and n, inclusive.
The time to pass through a tunnel is between 1 and 106, inclusive.
The number of different values of l is between 1 and 50, inclusive.
The value of l is between 1 and 1011, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: The output is a list of integers, each corresponding to the maximum number of children Drazil and Varda can have for a given value of l.
postconditions.description: The output should list the maximum number of children for each value of l, in the order they appear in the input.
